product_overview: Chnk it is an infinite-canvas, spatial note-taking application that lets users create rich text blocks and arrange them visually on a 2D plane. This summary is based on the Product Requirements Document (PRD, page 1) describing the product purpose and vision.
core_goals: Quickly capture ideas as rich text blocks and cards
Organize notes spatially on an infinite canvas to mirror mental models
Rearrange and iterate on note layout for planning and brainstorming
Preserve and recover local notes and backups for uninterrupted work

features.name: Block Editor
features.description: A rich text, block-based editor for creating and editing note content that can be arranged on the canvas.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Create new block -> Type text into block -> Finish editing block -> See the new block appear on the canvas
Navigate to / -> Create new block -> Type text into block -> Rearrange blocks -> See updated block order and positions on the canvas
Navigate to / -> Create new block -> Delete block -> See the block removed from the canvas

features.name: Canvas Board
features.description: An infinite canvas for visually organizing nodes and note cards, supporting spatial arrangement and zooming for overview and detail.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Add new node -> Move nodes around -> See nodes positioned where placed
Navigate to / -> Add new node -> Add multiple nodes -> Move nodes around to arrange layout -> Zoom out to view overall layout -> See nodes maintain relative positions
Navigate to / -> Add new node -> Zoom in and out -> See canvas scale and node positions update accordingly
